objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction subject to lifecycle control including creation, editing, release, distribution, and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation and consecutive number identifying the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid.

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: Configurable period for validity extension check (default 3 years).

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable retention period after invalidation (default 10 years).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Areas of validity or relevant companies for the document.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document that is versioned and released together with its main document; creation, modification or archiving triggers a new version of the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary sub-document not subject to a release cycle; can be published directly and deleted without affecting the main document version.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the additional info is published.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal suggestion to amend an existing released document, managed independently of the document version until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before document validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend, revise, or invalidate the document.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate (put out of force) a document and archive it, processed through a workflow.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated/archived document, restricted to the Business Admin group.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who participates in document processes in one or more roles (author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used to assign read, acknowledgement, or other collective authorizations.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Name of the user group (e.g. Reader - Document Management, Archive).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: The set of user groups and individual persons assigned to a document for email notification or acknowledgement upon release.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process instance that routes tasks through defined steps (e.g. Creator-Review-Release) with electronic signatures.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, translation release).

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new documents.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: A configurable classification category that defines abbreviation, validity period, archive duration, and available templates for documents.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system with selection of document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is modified using the integrated editing client.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata or attributes of a document are maintained or changed.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The saved document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step release workflow (Creator-Review-Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical or formal correctness and completes the task with electronic signature.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document with electronic signature, making it visible to readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: The released document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created for revision, retaining prior data.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: An attachment sub-document is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is changed, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: An additional info object is added to a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional info object is removed from a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for a released document by a user with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is documented as completed by the document author.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically generates a validity extension request 30 days before the document's valid-until date.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: The releaser (and optionally author/reviewer) processes the validity extension request via workflow.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The document validity is confirmed and the valid-until date is updated by the default period.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate and archive a document.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: The override request is processed through the workflow (releaser-only or initiator-reviewer-releaser).

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force; all rights except archive group are revoked and archiving begins.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: A document is physically deleted from the system after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A Business Admin group member creates a request to reactivate an invalidated document.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The initiator confirms reactivation, creating a new version of the document with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are notified by email upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement of the released document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A user confirms acknowledgement of a document via the workflow task.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or individual users for a document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated language version is reviewed and released via workflow, making it visible to readers in the corresponding language.
